scope: Prescribed min/max hold behaviour, result labels/side presentation/date format, existing runbook convergence. No estimator or clinical activation.

web_guided.scope: Synthetic programme and browser speech requests, not physical audibility or clinical content

native_guided.scope: Release simulator guided routine and existing reference/restart assertions; not the result card or a real patient

result_card.limit: Narrow/large-text presentation remains scrollable; do not infer effortless comprehension from rendering checks.

tool_limitations: One further compact-layout/README mutation was refused and did not execute. No alternate-route execution was used.
A subsequent read-only batch count/metadata query was refused twice; test success is reported from the managed command receipt rather than inventing its total.
The prior native result-driver restriction remains; the existing guided-native test is a different scope.
benchmark: No new run or download. This patch changes dose/UI, not the video estimator; previous 116deb2 RGB observations retain their own basis and limits.
clinical: No new hold/rest duration, tolerance, model qualification, patient method registration or prescription permission.
next: Independent review; narrow evaluation-only Check adapter and isolated receipt-aware storage/reopen, plus native result presentation and real-user/measurement qualification.
